[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This CoreSite cluster spans Fairfax County and Reston, Virginia, part of the Northern Virginia data center corridor. Wikipedia coverage states that in August 2016 CoreSite purchased the 22 acre Sunrise Technology Park in Reston for 60 million dollars, under then newly appointed CEO Paul Szurek, who replaced retiring CEO Tom Ray in July 2016. Northern Virginia is listed among CoreSite key operating markets as of June 2022. CoreSite was founded in 2001 as CRG West, rebranded to CoreSite in 2009, went public in 2010, and was acquired by American Tower in December 2021. This specific building, VA1, sits on the Sunrise Technology Park campus. CoreSites own Northern Virginia regional page and a separate dedicated operator spec sheet page (both tier-1 operator sources) agree this buildings address is 12100 Sunrise Valley Drive, Reston, VA 20191, with 261,000 plus square feet per the regional page. A third-party aggregator, DataCenterMap, lists what appears to be the same address under two different internal URL slugs but gives two different, mutually inconsistent square footage figures, 201,000 and 188,000, neither matching the operators own 261,000 plus figure, this aggregator inconsistency is noted but not relied upon. The Reston campus also includes a third building, VA3, at 12369 Sunrise Valley Drive, 244,000 plus square feet, carrying NVIDIA DGX-Ready certification per the operators own site, VA3 is not itself a row in this registry. No MW or power capacity figure was found for VA1 in any source checked this session.
